CCM02|CLABSI-22.old:
**Organism** | **Regimen**
CONS | May **retain** CVC + systemic Abx 7d + antibiotic lock 10-14d
S. aureus | Remove CVC, systemic Abx 14d if TOE-neg. Salvage possible: systemic + lock 14d if TOE-neg
Gram-negative bacilli | Remove CVC, treat 10-14d. Salvage: systemic + antimicrobial lock 14d
Candida | Remove CVC + antifungal 14d after first negative culture
